title: How big a cake for 25 guests? Eggless 12-inch from $89.99 near Schofields
summary:
How big a cake for 25 guests? A 12-inch serves 25 to 30. It starts at $89.99.

For a Schofields or Marsden Park party, the 10-inch serves 20 to 22 from $74.99. The 14-inch serves 40 to 45 from $114.99. Pick the size by headcount, not by how big the table looks.

Every cake is 100% eggless. Not in the sponge, not in the buttercream, not in any of the 15 flavours. Which is why one cake works for the whole guest list, with nobody checking labels.

Fresh to order, with 48 hours notice. Pickup at Riverstone Shopping Centre, free parking at the door. Send your size, flavour and a photo reference.
